gallery.name: Daily Dose Gallery
gallery.openingHours: Tuesday & Thursday, 10:00–16:00. Other days by appointment.

bio: Son of a painter and a puppeteer, Julián Villafañe grew up in a world of stories, puppets, colour and poetry. That world lives on in every canvas he paints: full of mystery, magic and life.
Self-taught and driven by instinct, he has been exhibiting since the mid-1990s, from art fairs across Venezuela to Nuestra América Gallery at the Consulate of Venezuela in New York.

exhibitions.title: Nuestra América Gallery, Consulate of Venezuela, New York

paragraphs: Daily Dose Gallery is built on one belief: art belongs in everyday life. Every morning, every evening, every time you walk past it.
We choose work that does something to you. Work that lifts you, calms you and makes you feel alive. A painting on your wall is a dose of joy you take every single day.

sections.statement: Art changes a room. And the person in it.
paragraphs: A painting brings warmth to a wall and life to a space. It gives your home character, a heart and a story of its own.
It works on you, too. Colour lifts your mood. A moment of looking slows you down and lets you breathe. Every day you see something new in it, and every day it feels a little more yours.
Hang it where you start your day. Where you come home. Where you rest. That is where it does its work.
Online, and at home in Blaricum. Easy to discover. Easy to live with.

contact.appointmentStatement: Come and see the work in person.
contact.appointmentText: Every painting looks different in real life. Visit us on Tuesday or Thursday, or send us an email to arrange another day. We look forward to welcoming you.

privacy.text: Daily Dose Gallery respects your privacy. This statement explains what personal data we collect, why, and what your rights are.
Who we are
Daily Dose Gallery, Meentweg 37 B, 1261 XS Blaricum, the Netherlands.
KvK 56314205 · hello@dailydosegallery.com
What data we collect
When you email us or click “Enquire”: your name, email address and the content of your message.
When you sign up for our newsletter: your email address.
When you buy a work: your name, address, email address, phone number and payment details, as needed to complete the sale and delivery.
Why we use your data
To answer your questions and enquiries.
To send you our newsletter, only if you signed up for it.
To complete and deliver a purchase, and to meet our legal and tax obligations.
We never sell your data and we do not use it for anything other than the purposes above.
Legal basis
We process your data because you asked us to (answering an enquiry), because you gave your consent (newsletter), to perform a sale, or because the law requires it (tax and accounting records).
How long we keep your data
Enquiries: up to two years after our last contact.
Newsletter: until you unsubscribe. Every newsletter contains an unsubscribe link.
Purchases: seven years, as required by Dutch tax law.
Who else sees your data

We work with a small number of trusted service providers who process data on our behalf, such as our website host (Netlify), our content system (Sanity) and our email and newsletter providers. They may only use your data to provide their service to us.
Cookies
Our website does not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Your rights

You have the right to see, correct or delete your personal data, to object to its use, and to receive a copy of it. You can also withdraw your consent at any time. Just email us at hello@dailydosegallery.com.
If you are not satisfied with how we handle your data, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
Changes
We may update this statement from time to time. The latest version is always on this page.
Last updated: November 2026.
